selection.rule: frame match + WordNet POS + single token (leading space) + explicit profanity/slur exclusion; h>=5 and h>1.5n (mirror for the neutral side)

excluded_families.noun: mined nouns are identity terms (boy/dude/lesbian/gay/white), not person-directed insults

attribution: Words derived from Jibes & Delights (Sodhi, Pant, Mamidi; WOAH 2021; repository ravsodhi/jibes-and-delights, Apache-2.0). Only derived word lists are shipped, no source text.
